notes.title: 🦀 King of Crabs Season 5: The Update is NOW LIVE!🦀
notes.notes:
Greetings, Crab Warriors!

We're thrilled to announce that [b]King of Crabs Season 5 is out![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/028b38066b35657b601a3ffcec2819b9fe935f3a.gif[/img]

[b][h2]🌟 Update Highlights 🌟[/h2][/b]

[h3]1️⃣ The Samurai Crab[/h3] Meet the embodiment of ancient warrior spirit. This magnificent crab comes equipped with a sharp Katana, a protective shield, and the deadly shurikens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/2a645f31a17685c0b0f838d4e036e84605e18529.gif[/img]

[h3]2️⃣Samurai Crab Skins:[/h3]

[b]👹Evil Skin:[/b] Immerse yourself in the mysteries of the night with this obsidian black skin, perfect for those stealthy maneuvers.


[b]🌟Gold Skin:[/b] A testament to the grandeur of ancient samurais, this luminous skin highlights your dominance on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/0969219395d03772078a782b25dca9b38955fdce.png[/img]

[h3]3️⃣ Sandstorm Mode:[/h3] A test of endurance and skill, this mode pits 100 players against each other with the encroaching danger of a relentless sandstorm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/1a4e199f0da6ab1e6454c03c31bb4a721a8b0546.gif[/img]

[h3]4️⃣The Flying Fish Pet:[/h3] This isn't just any pet; the Flying Fish has the special ability to heal you gradually, proving invaluable in your skirmish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/1eb7cc3f9b29ad67e79d4fa87f3d59b3f4b7f4f4.png[/img]

[h3]5️⃣ Battle Axe:[/h3] Show your might with every swing of this powerful weapon and ensure your supremacy in the deep blue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/6700864a18d214efea97402448fb950bd4fc22cc.png[/img]

[h3]6️⃣Ram Hat:[/h3] Turn heads (or break them) with the new hat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/f95880c42de61ae1c34f7977883476daf2cd4617.png[/img]

[h3]7️⃣ The Ancient Samurai Scrolls:[/h3] Explore the map for these collectible items to get great accolades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/3becf06249c6ad68bf0aced5c94b2cbb2935495b.png[/img]

[h3]8️⃣ Gameplay Improvements:[/h3]

👉 Economy change: You can now use coins to upgrade crabs directly.
👉 More advanced NPC behavior.
👉 Plus lots more!

[h3]9️⃣ Season 5 Content:[/h3]

👉 Earn up to 80 rewards from season progression.
👉 Embark on special Seasonal quests.
👉 Grab the King Pass for extra goodies.

Are you ready to embrace the samurai spirit? 
Dive into Season 5 now and let us know what you think!

Happy Crabbing! 🦀

P.S. Don't miss out on the latest news about our games -[b] [url=https://twitter.com/RobotSquid_]follow us on Twitter![/url][/b]

notes.title: Season 4 Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Thanks for your patience while we worked out the kinks from our newest Season which includes; nerfing the golden-wreathed mantis shrimp, being able to collect those pesky new skills, and re-introducing the Mace of Giants! (with some changes).

As always, thank you for playing King of Crabs and reporting these bugs and issues through our community channels. We really appreciate it!

[b] Balancing [/b]
[list]
[*] A crab special now has a limit when scaling off of the weapon multiplier.
[*] Reduced the amount of special gained by extremely high damage attacks.
[*] Mantis Shrimp no longer gains additional special from its attack.
[/list]
[b] Changes [/b]
[list]
[*] The Mace of Giants no longer makes your crab larger. Instead, the Mace of Giants is HUGE and has an added attack bonus.
[*] If you are picking up an item and have no item of that type (shield, melee, ranged) on your crab, the item pickup timer is much quicker.
[/list]
[b] Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple server crashes
[*] The Chest Key can now be locked/unlocked in the Legacy Weapon Mode.
[*] The pink Robo and Alien crab textures.
[*] Not being able to collect the new skills from the rank screen if you had already collected the rewards previously in those rank slots.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10 is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
IT'S SO CLAW-SOME!

[previewyoutube=rayceBFw9Uk;full][/previewyoutube]

We're also having a [b]JUMBO SIZED[/b] stream to celebrate this [b]JUMBO SIZED[/b] update - watch as Andrew... or at least some kind of [i]monstrous [/i]Crab/Mutant version of Andrew tries to master all the latest content live!

- Ranged Weapons (Shotgun and Flamethrower) add a whole new layer to the combat! Found in crates, they are droppable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/87050039ed031e6aa52425eadad45a82e8437d17.png[/img]

- Ammo drops for your weapons mean if you're smart you can keep on shooting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/7b8bd7ec09fdc6c4761c526998326a39c12342fe.png[/img]

- Weapon Locking system which - if toggled on - means you won't auto-swap to a new weapon the moment you run over it!

-Barbeque food is generated from death-by-fire (Flamethrower bbq time!). This food gives more health, growth and score.

- Brand new Demon Crab (Legendary!) for players to unlock, with a unique Vortex Special Attack! ALso comes with 2 skins to unlock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/a3228a9b3043235580878196a56399a923184bee.png[/img]

- MEGA BIG gameplay! Collect all the letters M-E-G-A-B-I-G and you'll be super-sized for a short time, and able to smash up scenery!?! The letters can be found in crates, chests, on the map, inside destructibles and even by killing the King!

- When MEGA BIG you are 250%+ size with huge Strength and Health, however health drain is high and accelerates over time. Once MEGA BIG is over, you return to regular size.

- While MEGA BIG you're able to destroy Trees, Rocks, Bones & Walls! They give good health and points, helping you to stay MEGA BIG for longer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/3e7204a2e0ad48b6315a63fcf954900ca7c90fd5.png[/img]

-Points bonuses for kill streaks 5, 10 and 20 player kills without dying, revenge kills and multi-kills. 

-NPCs use special attacks on you when you are 100% and get more aggressive over time. 

-Bigger overall buff from being King Crab

-Be MEGA BIG to destroy Trees, Rocks, bones & walls, They give good health and points. Helps you to stay big for longer. 

- New Durability pickups found in crates. These increase the life of your weapons!

- Coin earnings from Crabs decided much more by the Crab level.

- You now get a free Continue if killed by someone more than 250% your size.

- You're made invincible for 4 secs after spawn, to protect you against other players.

- Leaderboard presentation refresh 

- Shop Refresh  

- 1 New Skin for all Common, Rare and Super Rare Crabs!

- Numerous other minor balancing changes.

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE COMING
notes.notes:
SLAP YER PEEPERS AROUND THIS!

[previewyoutube=smkd2B4i_Cw;full][/previewyoutube]


That's right, we're bringing FIREARMS to King of Crabs with the V2.10 release coming... soon!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/87050039ed031e6aa52425eadad45a82e8437d17.png[/img]
The shotgun will riddle your enemies at range, blasting them with high damage attacks before they can close the distance! I'm not sure how such a tiny sawn-off came into existence, but don't worry too much about that - all you need is to get your claws clamped around the trigger and you'll be making crabsticks with your boomstick in no time at all!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624943/7b8bd7ec09fdc6c4761c526998326a39c12342fe.png[/img]
The flamethrower lets you flambé and roast your foes to make them even tastier than before! This kitchen tool is usually deployed to add a touch of colour and flavour to dishes, crisping the edge of a delicious scallop or melting the cheese on a burger to perfection... but it works on crabs just fine too! A a ranged weapon for the real Crabby Connoisseur, your enemies will have no choice but to tip their (chef's) hat as you char them into oblivion!

But we're not stopping there!

[list]
[*]Where there are weapons there is ammo, so there'll be new pickups for that!
[*]You'll be able to 'lock' your weapon swap, so when you get your fave weapon in your claws, you won't auto-swap to another by running over it accidentally. Optional of course, but we now a few crustaceans who'll really love this toggle.
[/list]

Let us know what do you think about these additions in the discussion pages, and keep an eye out for more news and feature teases in... precisely one week from now!

notes.title: King of Crabs GAME LAUNCH and patch v1.8.1!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for playing, because the launch has gone [i]SO WELL[/i]! Over 50k players so far, countless hours of crab-smashing, mad streams by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/xqcow]huge celebrities like xQc[/url]! We couldn't be happier!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0NleOeU.png[/img]

As we continue to work towards the first big update (follow us and the game here on Steam, and join in on [url=https://discord.gg/spiltmilk]the discord[/url] to be the first to know our plans), the dev team has also been slaving away night and day to bring you this small update which fixes some of the most common and egregious bugs we've spotted!

[list]
[*] Improvements to movement control using mouse.
[*] Changes to default keyboard controls (makes it easier to get into the game first time)
[*] Server connection improvements, so if you've been having a laggy experience so far that should be sorted!
[*] Gain more Extra Lifes during play from Golden Hermits, Giant Conches and Crates.
[*] Boost, and Super Boost speeds slightly lower.
[*] Brown Crab special duration slightly shorter
[*] Brown Crab special charges faster
[*] Shorter Freeze durations
[*] Ice Wand has lower durability
[*] Poison Dagger has lower durability
[*] Shorter Dazed duration
[*] King's Shield has higher durability
[*] Robot Crab's rockets have slightly more range.
[*] Rainbow Crab's special causes more damage but is shorter duration.
[*] Fewer Rainbow Crab NPCs.
[*] Robot Squid Hat has reduced damage reduction.
[*] Free Extra Life size threshold increased.
[*] Extra Life ramp up slower
[*] Fixed graphical issues in-game
[*] Fixed a controls issue, meaning you won't get stuck boosting and not stopping
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]


Happy battling!

PS: yes, this is actually the second patch we've pushed for those of you paying attention, but this summarises the changes so worry not...
